title: E2E scenario harness
acceptance: node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/e2e/ exits 0 even when other modules are missing
scenarios.test.mjs boots createApp on port 0 with a temp db and the real tenants dir and closes it in after()
Per scenario x tenant it runs steps: report, upload documents, bus drain, coverage, triage, routing/STP, adjuster first view, each asserting an outbox event and comparing scenario.expected
Missing module/endpoint (404 or undefined ctx.modules.x) yields t.todo with a reason, never a failure
Works with tests/synthetic/index.mjs when present and falls back to a local fake in tests/e2e/fakes/ when absent
brief: Create tests/e2e/scenarios.test.mjs and helpers in tests/e2e/ (harness.mjs, fakes/synthetic-fallback.mjs, steps.mjs). Read architecture/core-runtime-api.md (createApp signature, ctx.forTenant(t), bus drain, outbox access, port 0) and openapi.yaml for endpoints and auth headers. Do not depend on S1-QE-02 landing: dynamic import('../synthetic/index.mjs') in try/catch; if missing, use fakes/synthetic-fallback.mjs that implements the same contract (generatePolicies, SCENARIOS, generateScenario returning name, lob, lossType, intakeAnswers, claimCreate, documents, expected) with 2 trivial scenarios. Tenants: list tenants dir ids; if none exist yet, mark everything t.todo with reason. A scenario applies to a tenant if tenant config lists the lob (when config declares lobs), else to all. Seed policies via ctx.forTenant(t).modules.coverage?.seedPolicies when defined, else todo coverage-dependent steps. Step pattern: a helper step(t, name, fn) that catches a NotImplemented outcome (HTTP 404/501 or missing module) and calls t.todo(reason); real assertion failures fail normally. After each step await bus drain (per core API) and query the outbox for the expected event type from contracts/events (look up exact names, do not invent); assert it exists for the claim. Compare coverageStatus, severityBand, fraud, subrogation, fastTrack against scenario.expected only when the step produced data. Use node:test subtests per scenario/tenant, node:http/fetch for calls, os.tmpdir mkdtemp for db and cleanup. Add a small tests/e2e/harness.test.mjs verifying the todo-mapping logic and that createApp boots. Pitfalls: always close the server and db, no fixed ports, keep runtime under ~30s.

verdicts.reason: All 5 criteria met; e2e suite exits 0 (29 pass, 0 fail, 120 todo with reasons); boots createApp port 0 with temp db + real tenants; per-step outbox asserts and expected comparison; synthetic fallback present.
